_doc: The MSP Mastermind bot: one Grok bot that orchestrates, and seven jobs that get people signed up for a mastermind. Each routine hands one job (jobs/<job>.md) to the Claude Code CLI through tools/job.py. tools/team.py, tools/install.py and tools/check.py read this.
name: the MSP Mastermind bot

agents.does: Fills a mastermind of managed service provider owners: the list, the invitations, the replies, the calls, the members, the posts and the nightly count
routines: Run python3 /workspace/msp-mastermind/repo/tools/job.py run invite. Then do the send steps in your memory for this routine

First save each new reply from the signed-in mailbox and LinkedIn to /workspace/msp-mastermind/data/inbox/<date>/, one text file per message with FROM and SUBJECT at the top. Then run python3 /workspace/msp-mastermind/repo/tools/job.py run replies. Then do the send steps in your memory for this routine

First save today's and tomorrow's mastermind calls from the signed-in calendar, and any new call notes or transcript, to /workspace/msp-mastermind/data/calls/<date>.md. Then run python3 /workspace/msp-mastermind/repo/tools/job.py run calls. Then do the send steps in your memory for this routine
Run python3 /workspace/msp-mastermind/repo/tools/job.py run report. Then post /workspace/msp-mastermind/daily/<date>/report.md, as it is, to the owner in this chat, and to Slack if it is connected
